description: This file is a shell script used to test Git pack-objects functionality, specifically focusing on the behavior of .keep pack files and the exclusion of certain objects in various pack configurations.

methods.name: rev_list_objects
methods.description: Function that runs 'git rev-list' with provided arguments, outputs sorted result, used to list objects in git repositories.

methods.name: idx_objects
methods.description: Function that shows the index of a pack file and extracts object hashes, used for comparison in tests.
